subject: Gate 8 must check required INPUTS, not just class existence - and must EXECUTE INPUT_TYPES
body:
MPI-498 is settled and its root fix is in YOUR file (scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs), which I have not touched - a live matrix is running from it.

WHAT GATE 8 MISSED. MpiScaledDimensions gained a REQUIRED upscale_method in MpiNodes ba9e156 (2026-07-16), an ancestor of all three pins. Six shipped graph nodes never supplied it (nvidia_pid.json 1609/1618/1619/1623, flow_sdxl_4k.json 1603/1615). Gate 8 checks that every Mpi* class_type EXISTS at the pinned commit; class existence was never the failing condition, so this survived two releases and two GPU matrices. Note the input's default IS lanczos and that changes nothing - execution.py:901 tests `if x not in inputs` and raises required_input_missing before any default is read.

WHY IT SCORED PASS AT 4s/1-MEDIA. MpiLoadImageFromPath subclasses PreviewImage and sets OUTPUT_NODE = True (img.py:380). The INPUT LOADER is therefore a valid output node with no upstream deps. It survives validation while every real PreviewImage is dropped, so ComfyUI answers 200 + prompt_id + node_errors and executes ONLY the loader branch - which emits the input image as an in-graph preview. Media count 1, four seconds, nothing sampled. Your MPI-495 node_errors guard is what finally caught it; media count alone never could, and neither could a wall-clock floor, since cold multi-stage transitions are legitimately slow.

THE ASK: extend gate 8 to diff each Mpi* node's REQUIRED inputs against the pinned commit's INPUT_TYPES. It reproduces this offline, free, on --plan, exactly as the class check already reproduces a missing class.

TRAP TO AVOID, measured today: ~120 Mpi* nodes in the shipped graphs build INPUT_TYPES PROGRAMMATICALLY - MpiAnySwitch, MpiAnySwitch10, MpiPacker, MpiClearVram, MpiSimpleBoolean, MpiBoolean. A static/AST parse of the pinned source sees no required-input literal for any of them and silently reports 0 holes for the MAJORITY of first-party nodes. Gate 8 must EXECUTE INPUT_TYPES at the pinned commit, or read /object_info from the Pod, not parse source.

ALREADY DONE BY ME, do not redo: upscale_method=lanczos added to all six API nodes and their raw twins. Raw matters - workflow-to-api.mjs consumes widgets_values positionally, so a short raw re-drops the input on the next export. Verified by an AST sweep: 6 holes at HEAD, 0 now. Still owed: a GPU re-run of nvidia-pid/pid and flow_sdxl_4k when the Pod frees up. Expect PASS at a real generation time instead of 4s.

WIDER POINT FOR THE 1.4 UMBRELLA: this exact failure mode was already survived once. ab9caa71 (2026-07-17 10:54) hand-patched 'add required block_if_empty to all MpiLoad* nodes' twelve minutes after the raw sync, with no sweep for other nodes carrying the same gap. A node-pack change that adds a required input does not force a re-export of graphs already frozen on disk, and nothing checks shipped graphs against the pinned node schema. That is the hole, and gate 8 is where it closes.

-- ADDED AFTER THE FIRST WRITE, so this message is self-contained for whoever holds the umbrella --

1. THE GPU RE-RUN IS OWED AND IT IS YOURS. I could not run it - the Pod was held by your live matrix,
and creating a second Pod fires the name-based orphan sweep that already deleted a live matrix Pod
once today. Command, when the Pod frees up:
  node scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs --models nvidia-pid --keep-volume --volume aghcuvg7nl
(--plan first; it spends nothing. The volume pin is not optional - aghcuvg7nl is a CONTENT asset that
feeds Fabio's YouTube recordings, never a scratch volume to delete.)
PASS CRITERIA, all three - a green line alone is what got us here:
  a) no 'partial validation' in the result line (that is your MPI-495 guard staying quiet)
  b) media >= 1
  c) a PLAUSIBLE generation time. The broken run scored PASS at 4s/1-media. Do not hard-code a
     wall-clock floor as a gate - cold multi-stage transitions are legitimately several times slower
     than warm ones, so a threshold would flap. Read it as a human sanity check on this one op.

2. FLOWS ARE OUTSIDE THE SMOKE MATRIX ENTIRELY - but check MPI-332 before carding anything.
MECHANISM: resolveSmokeSet enumerates MODELS x m.supportedOps and resolves the file through
resolveWorkflowFile, which reads model.workflows[op] and nothing else. Flow ops live in
js/data/flowsRegistry.js, no model declares flowSdxl4k in supportedOps (grep: 0 hits in models.js), and
no flow_*.json appears in any model's workflows map. So no flow_*.json can ever be reached by the
runner. That is why this bug surfaced only on PiD: flow_sdxl_4k carried the identical defect on all
THREE of its PreviewImage outputs and no matrix could have seen it. I found it by sweeping the graphs
statically, not by running anything.

SCOPE - I FIRST WROTE 'four shipped graphs never smoked'. THAT OVERSTATES IT. Of the four flows in
flowsRegistry.js (image-regen, sdxl-4k, video-stitch, head-swap), THREE are already carded for removal:
MPI-332 'Rip the 3 deprecated test apps (image-regen, sdxl-4k, video-stitch) - keep Head Swap', todo,
created 2026-07-21. They were plumbing tests for the Flow-Library carousel (MPI-256/259/306), never
released. Head Swap (MPI-299) is flow #1 of the real product. Nothing in the CODE says any of this -
grep finds no deprecation flag, comment or gate in flowsRegistry.js, so the registry reads as four
equal live flows. The board is the only place it is written down. Consequences:
  * The only flow worth giving smoke coverage is HEAD-SWAP (flow_head_swap.json). Do not build runner
    support for four flows when MPI-332 deletes three of them.
  * flow_sdxl_4k does NOT need a manual dispatch to confirm my fix - it is one of the three being
    ripped. Its two nodes are patched and the static sweep is clean; do not spend a GPU on it. If
    MPI-332 lands first, my edit to that file simply goes away with it. Harmless either way.
  * flow_head_swap.json uses no MpiScaledDimensions, so it is unaffected by MPI-498 - but it is exposed
    to the SAME CLASS of defect, which is the argument for gate 8, not against it.

MPI-332's FILE LIST IS STALE - flag for whoever executes it. The card was written 2026-07-21, BEFORE
985faa09 (2026-08-06) renamed the App system to Flows. It names js/data/appsRegistry.js, the ops
appImageRegen / appSdxl4k / appVideoStitch, and comfy_workflows/app_sdxl_4k.json + app_video_test.json +
app_sdxl_regen.json. On disk today those are js/data/flowsRegistry.js, flowImageRegen / flowSdxl4k /
flowVideoStitch, and flow_sdxl_4k.json / flow_video_test.json / flow_sdxl_regen.json. Its blast-radius
sweep was verified against the pre-rename tree and needs re-running before anyone deletes by that list.

3. RELEASE DECISION IS YOURS, and it needs the timing: the MPI-495 node_errors guard is NOT in v1.3.1
(2e045187 is not an ancestor of the tag). So a 1.3.0/1.3.1 user running PiD gets their source image
echoed back with NO error, no toast, no log line - it reads as a completed upscale. Two live user-
facing paths were affected for three weeks: the PiD model and the SDXL 4K Flow. Whether that is a
1.3.2 hotfix or waits for 1.4 is the umbrella's call, not mine. I deliberately wrote NO changelog
line - do not let one get written before the GPU re-run exists.

4. STATE OF THE TREE. The fix is on disk, UNCOMMITTED, four files. MPI-498 is in `doing` with
tasks/MPI-498/files.json declaring ownership, and I hold write claims in state/index.json on:
  comfy_workflows/nvidia_pid.json, comfy_workflows/flow_sdxl_4k.json,
  comfy_workflows/raw/nvidia_pid.json, comfy_workflows/raw/flow_sdxl_4k.json
I have touched nothing else - not scripts/smoke-workflows.mjs, not dev_configs/, not the playbook.
If you need to re-export either graph from raw, tell me rather than editing under the claim.

5. REPRODUCE MY VERIFICATION IN ONE STEP, if you want it independent of my word: AST-read every Mpi*
class's `required` INPUT_TYPES keys out of the MpiNodes source, then diff against every Mpi* node in
every comfy_workflows/*.json. Against HEAD it flags exactly 6 nodes; against the working tree, 0.
Remember trap #2 above though - that same AST approach reports 0 for the ~120 nodes whose
INPUT_TYPES is built programmatically, so it is a good enough check for THIS fix and NOT good enough
to be gate 8.
resolution: Resolved - MPI-467 replied, accepted every item, and carried gate 8 plus the GPU re-run onto the umbrella handoff. Section 2 was corrected before hand-off to point at MPI-332.
